blocks.text: OpenAI 于 6 月向美国证券交易委员会（SEC）秘密提交了 IPO 招股说明书。首席财务官 Sarah Friar 在 8 月对员工表示，OpenAI 将在 2027 年前成为上市公司。首席执行官 Sam Altman 在 9 月表示，时机不利于上市。他早在 6 月就已在内部传达了这一点。竞争对手 Anthropic 也在筹备 IPO，目标估值在 1.5 万亿至 2 万亿美元之间。

blocks.text: OpenAI is closing in on a new funding round of up to $30 billion but has lowered its valuation target to get there. The company originally pitched investors on a $1.4 trillion valuation, according to internal documents obtained by the Financial Times. That number has since dropped to $1.25 trillion, CNBC also reports. The FT says demand was weaker than in previous rounds, with some backers experiencing "indigestion" after heavy investments in earlier fundraises.

blocks.text: UAE investors and investment firm Coatue are leading the $30 billion round. The funding is being positioned as a bridge ahead of a potential IPO. OpenAI is also negotiating a commercial deal to secure additional compute capacity through the UAE, according to CNBC.

blocks.text: OpenAI confidentially filed an IPO prospectus with the SEC in June. CFO Sarah Friar told employees in August that OpenAI would be a publicly traded company by 2027. CEO Sam Altman said in September that the timing was unfavorable for going public. He had already communicated that internally back in June. Competitor Anthropic is also preparing an IPO and is targeting a valuation between $1.5 and $2 trillion.
